name: review-findings
description: Deprecated for AI-DLC: approval-gates 1.22.0 puts stage review findings on the gate page; this plugin steps aside for them and only handles code review. When review findings reach the developer (an AI-DLC stage review at its approval gate, or a code review), shows each open finding in plain words with a suggested action, above one question: Fix, Accept (only when nothing blocks) or Open in form. A hook keeps the order.

suggestModel.title: Suggestion model
suggestModel.description: Full model id that writes a one-sentence suggested action for each finding whose reviewer named none (a code review's findings, mostly). "off" leaves the fixed line.

answerSummary.title: Summary of the answers
answerSummary.description: After you answer Fix or Accept, the agent prints a summary of your answers before it acts. Set to false to skip it: the agent acts on your answer straight away.
